home.badge: A Governed Operating System for Unions
home.heroHeading: Command every dimension of your union.
home.heroDescription: Grievances. Finances. Membership. Compliance. One governed platform — total transparency, total accountability, zero guesswork.
home.problemHeading: Unions Deserve Better Than Spreadsheets and Guesswork
home.problemDescription: Grievances tracked in notebooks. Finances reconciled in spreadsheets. Member records scattered across drives. Employers have million-dollar HR systems — unions have manual processes that lose cases, delay reports, and erode trust.
home.solutionHeading: A Platform Built for How Unions Actually Operate
home.solutionDescription: Union Eyes is a governed operating system — not another SaaS tool. Every deployment is scoped by contract, every module is activated by entitlement, and every action is logged for audit. Billing flows from the parent organization down. Data stays in Canadian jurisdiction.
home.step1Desc: Parent organization signs a deployment contract scoping modules, locals, and terms
home.step2Desc: Modules are activated per entitlement — nothing is enabled by default
home.step3Desc: Parent allocates billing and module access to each local organization
home.step4Desc: Controlled pilot rollout with health monitoring and readiness assessment
home.step5Desc: Ongoing audit trails, financial reconciliation, and compliance reporting
home.governanceHeading: Built for the People Who Sign Off
home.governanceDescription: Union executives, finance officers, and legal teams need a platform they can defend — to their members, their boards, and their auditors.
home.gov1Desc: Every action — case updates, financial entries, role changes — is logged with tamper-evident records.
home.gov2Desc: 35+ union-specific roles with granular permissions. Members see what they should. Officers see what they must.
home.gov3Desc: All data stored in Canadian Azure data centres. PIPEDA compliant. No cross-border transfers.
home.gov4Desc: Dues, per capita, strike fund — consolidated across locals with parent-level oversight and export-ready reports.
home.modulesHeading: Activate What You Need. Nothing More.
home.modulesDescription: Each module is independently entitled and activated per contract. No bundling, no forced upsells.
home.module1Desc: Audit trails, role enforcement, entitlement controls, and compliance dashboards.
home.module2Desc: Intake to arbitration lifecycle with evidence packs, precedent research, and triage.
home.module3Desc: Parent-level billing, local allocation, dues tracking, and treasury reconciliation.
home.module4Desc: Self-service claims, dues visibility, document management, and communications.
home.module5Desc: AI-assisted triage, custom reports, trend analysis, and executive dashboards — always optional, always governed.
home.socialProofDescription: Union Eyes is in controlled pilot deployment with Canadian labour organizations. Every rollout follows a structured contract, readiness assessment, and phased activation.
home.finalCtaHeading: Ready to See It in Action?
home.finalCtaDescription: No pitch deck. No sales pressure. Start with a controlled pilot scoped to your organization's real needs.
home.missionDescription: Union Eyes was born when a healthcare representative lost a winnable grievance because her notes were trapped in a spreadsheet. The employer had a million-dollar HR system. She had a notebook. We built a governed platform to close that gap — and we deploy it through controlled pilots to get it right.

story.heroHeading: Two brothers. Two careers. One shared conviction.
story.heroDescription: A Labour Relations Officer turned lawyer and a CIO turned SaaS builder — together they are building the operating system that unions have never had.
story.pageDescription: Union Eyes was founded by two brothers who lived the gaps in union infrastructure — and decided to close them.

pricing.heroDescription: Union Eyes is deployed through governed contracts — not self-serve subscriptions. Pricing is scoped to your organization, your modules, and your rollout plan.
pricing.pageDescription: Contract-based deployment pricing for Canadian unions. Parent-level billing with local allocation.

contact.heroDescription: No sales pressure. We’re here to answer questions about deployment, compliance, and how Union Eyes fits your organization’s governance requirements.
contact.pageDescription: Get in touch with the Union Eyes team about deployment and governance.

caseStudies.heroDescription: How Canadian unions deploy Union Eyes through governed contracts, phased rollouts, and structured pilots.
caseStudies.pageDescription: How Canadian unions deploy Union Eyes through governed contracts and controlled pilots.

pilotRequest.heroDescription: Every Union Eyes deployment begins with a scoped pilot — structured around your organization's governance, modules, and readiness.
pilotRequest.pageDescription: Begin a governed pilot deployment of Union Eyes scoped to your organization.

status.heroDescription: Real-time operational status of Union Eyes platform services
status.pageDescription: Real-time status of Union Eyes platform services.

footer.description: A governed operating system for Canadian unions — contract-based deployment, module-level entitlements, and audit-ready operations.
footer.tagline: A governed operating system for unions.

grievanceTracking.pageDescription: End-to-end grievance lifecycle — from intake to arbitration. Evidence packs, precedent research, and AI-assisted triage with full audit trails.
grievanceTracking.heroHeading: Grievance management with a defensible evidence chain
grievanceTracking.heroDescription: Track every case from intake to resolution with tamper-evident evidence packs, precedent research, and structured workflows — all audit-logged and role-controlled.
grievanceTracking.feat1Desc: A step-by-step filing form that captures grievance type, priority, incident details, and desired outcome — so nothing gets missed at intake.
grievanceTracking.feat2Desc: Every grievance moves through intake, triage, investigation, mediation, arbitration, and settlement with clear status and audit trail at every step.
grievanceTracking.feat3Desc: Search labour arbitration case law by similarity. Get strengths, weaknesses, and critical factors surfaced to prepare stronger cases.
grievanceTracking.feat4Desc: Bundle documents into evidence packs with SHA-256 hash chain verification stored in immutable cloud storage. Built for arbitration defensibility.
grievanceTracking.feat5Desc: Filter by status, priority, employer, or representative. See workload at a glance — active cases, overdue items, and average days in each stage.
grievanceTracking.feat6Desc: Optional AI scoring for priority, complexity, and category. Suggests relevant CBA clauses and precedents. Always under human control — enabled per organization via entitlement.
grievanceTracking.howItWorksHeading: How a grievance moves through the system
grievanceTracking.ctaDescription: This module is available through controlled pilot deployment. Request a walkthrough scoped to your organization's case management needs.

memberPortal.pageDescription: Member self-service with claims tracking, dues visibility, document management, and communications — governed by role-based access and organizational entitlements.
memberPortal.heroDescription: Self-service for members. Less phone calls for representatives. Claims tracking, dues visibility, and document access — all role-controlled and audit-logged.
memberPortal.feat1Desc: Searchable directory with seniority tracking, status management, and bulk operations. Import, export, or merge records with full audit trail.
memberPortal.feat2Desc: Step-by-step onboarding for new members. Collect information, assign roles, and get people up to speed from day one.
memberPortal.feat3Desc: Members can file benefit and insurance claims, track status in real time, and see updates without calling the hall. Transparency builds trust.
memberPortal.feat4Desc: Members see their balance, payment history, and next payment date. Less confusion, fewer phone calls, better record-keeping for everyone.
memberPortal.feat5Desc: Upload, version, and share documents with approval workflows and retention policies. No more emailing attachments back and forth.
memberPortal.feat6Desc: Messages, notifications, and subscription preferences for email and SMS. Reach members on their terms without spamming.
memberPortal.feat7Desc: See participation metrics, activity trends, and communication effectiveness at a glance. Understand who's engaged and who needs outreach.
memberPortal.member1: See your claims and their status in real time
memberPortal.member2: Check your dues balance without calling the office
memberPortal.member3: Upload documents securely from any device
memberPortal.member4: Get notifications on your terms (email or SMS)
memberPortal.steward1: Onboard new members with a guided wizard
memberPortal.steward3: Track engagement and identify disengaged members
memberPortal.steward4: Manage documents with version control and approvals
memberPortal.ctaHeading: Ready for a member portal that works?
memberPortal.ctaDescription: This module is activated through your deployment contract. Start a pilot to see how it handles your real workflows.

aiWorkbench.pageDescription: AI-assisted triage, precedent research, CBA extraction, custom reports, and executive dashboards — always governed, always optional, always audited.
aiWorkbench.heroHeading: Intelligence tools that representatives control — not the other way around
aiWorkbench.heroDescription: Research precedents in minutes. Get suggested arguments from case history. Generate reports for your executive board. All governed by entitlements, all audit-logged, all optional.
aiWorkbench.cap1Desc: AI scores incoming grievances by priority, complexity, and category. Suggests relevant CBA clauses and precedents to accelerate early-stage decisions.
aiWorkbench.cap2Desc: Find similar labour arbitration cases by describing your situation. Get outcome analysis with strengths, weaknesses, and critical factors surfaced.
aiWorkbench.cap3Desc: Upload a collective bargaining agreement PDF and the AI extracts, tags, and cross-references clauses automatically. No manual indexing required.
aiWorkbench.cap4Desc: Generate structured legal memorandums, argument summaries, and case briefs for arbitration prep. Always reviewed and edited by representatives before use.
aiWorkbench.cap5Desc: Custom report builder, leadership dashboards, financial summaries, and trend analysis — built for the people who need to make decisions and explain them.
aiWorkbench.capabilitiesHeading: What the Intelligence module can do
aiWorkbench.safeguardsDescription: We don't believe AI should make decisions for workers. These tools assist — you decide.
aiWorkbench.safe1Desc: Every AI capability is off by default. Organization admins enable them individually when they're ready.
aiWorkbench.safe2Desc: Every AI decision includes a reasoning chain — you can see exactly why a suggestion was made and override it.
aiWorkbench.safe3Desc: AI usage is budget-capped per organization through the billing allocation. No runaway costs, no surprises.
aiWorkbench.ctaHeading: See the Intelligence module in action
aiWorkbench.ctaDescription: This module is available through controlled pilot deployment. Book a walkthrough to see how it handles real grievance and reporting workflows.

analytics.pageDescription: Parent-level billing, local allocation, dues and per capita tracking, treasury reconciliation, and tax compliance — all under a single governed financial framework.
analytics.heroHeading: Financial control from the parent down to every local
analytics.heroDescription: One contract. One invoice. Transparent allocation to every local and chapter. Dues tracking, per capita calculations, and treasury reconciliation — all audit-ready.
analytics.feat1Desc: A single contract covers your entire deployment. The parent organization receives one invoice. No per-seat surprises, no hidden tiers.
analytics.feat2Desc: Allocate costs across locals, chapters, and regions by membership count, module usage, or custom formula. Every allocation is transparent and auditable.
analytics.feat3Desc: Track dues collection, per capita obligations, and remittance schedules per local. Automated calculations, variance alerts, and historical reporting.
analytics.feat4Desc: Match platform billing against bank statements and internal ledgers. Flag discrepancies before they become audit findings.
analytics.feat5Desc: Generate T4/T4A slips, track GST/HST obligations, and produce year-end financial summaries. Designed for Canadian union tax requirements.
analytics.feat6Desc: Set spending limits per local, per module, or per AI capability. Alerts fire before limits are reached — never after.
analytics.feat7Desc: Consolidated views for treasurers, CFOs, and executive boards. Revenue, expenses, fund balances, and allocation status at a glance.
analytics.useCaseHeading: Built for real union financial governance
analytics.roleStewardsDesc: Reconciliation, dues tracking, and T4 generation. Everything you need without three different spreadsheets.
analytics.roleOfficersDesc: Consolidated financials, allocation transparency, and budget variance reporting for executive board meetings.
analytics.roleTreasurersDesc: Single-invoice billing, top-down allocation visibility, and per capita compliance across all affiliated locals.
analytics.ctaHeading: See the financial module in action
analytics.ctaDescription: This module is activated through your deployment contract. Start a pilot to see how it handles real financial workflows and allocation rules.

security.pageDescription: How Union Eyes protects your data with encryption, access controls, and continuous security monitoring.
security.heading: Security
security.intro: Union data is sensitive. We treat security as a foundational requirement, not an afterthought. This page outlines how Union Eyes protects your organization's information.
security.encryptionDesc: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Database connections are encrypted end-to-end. Secrets and API keys are stored in Azure Key Vault — never in source code or environment files.
security.accessControlDesc: Union Eyes uses role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure members only see what they're authorized to see. Authentication is handled by Clerk with multi-factor authentication support. Database queries are scoped by organization to enforce strict data isolation between unions.
security.infrastructureDesc: Union Eyes is hosted on Microsoft Azure in Canadian data centres, ensuring your data stays within Canadian jurisdiction. We use container isolation, automated security scanning of dependencies and Docker images, and enforce strict Content Security Policy headers across all applications.
security.monitoringDesc: All access to sensitive data is logged with a full audit trail. We run automated vulnerability scanning on every code change, including static analysis (CodeQL), dependency audits, secret scanning, and container image scanning (Trivy). Rate limiting protects API endpoints from abuse.
security.vulnDesc: If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly by emailing
security.vulnAck: . We acknowledge reports within 24 hours and provide a fix timeline within 72 hours. Please do not file public issues for security matters.
security.complianceDesc: Union Eyes is designed to comply with PIPEDA (Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act) and applicable Canadian provincial privacy legislation. For more details, see our
security.questionsDesc: If you have questions about our security practices, contact us at

privacy.pageDescription: How Union Eyes collects, uses, and protects your personal information under PIPEDA and Canadian privacy law.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectDesc: Union Eyes collects information necessary to provide union management services, including: name, email address, union membership details, and usage data. We collect this information when you create an account, use our platform, or interact with our services.
privacy.useDesc: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you about your account, process grievances and voting, and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.storageDesc: All data is stored in Canadian data centres in compliance with PIPEDA (Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act). We use industry-standard encryption for data in transit and at rest, and implement strict access controls.
privacy.rightsDesc: Under Canadian privacy law, you have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal information. You can exercise these rights through your account settings or by contacting us at
privacy.retentionDesc: We retain your personal information only as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. When you delete your account, your data is permanently removed within 30 days.
privacy.contactDesc: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact our Privacy Officer at

terms.pageDescription: Terms and conditions governing the use of Union Eyes union management platform.
terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceDesc: By accessing or using Union Eyes, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Union Eyes is a platform designed for union organizations in Canada and is governed by Canadian law.
terms.useDesc: You may use Union Eyes solely for lawful union management purposes, including grievance tracking, member communication, voting, and organizational administration. You agree not to misuse the platform or attempt to access it through unauthorized means.
terms.billingDesc: Deployments are billed under an organizational contract. The parent body receives a single invoice with transparent allocation across locals. Contract terms, module selection, and billing frequency are defined during onboarding.
terms.liabilityDesc: Union Eyes is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform. Our total liability shall not exceed the fees paid by you in the twelve months preceding the claim.
terms.terminationDesc: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms. Upon termination, your data will be retained for 30 days to allow export, after which it will be permanently deleted.
terms.contactDesc: Questions about these terms? Contact us at

accessibility.pageDescription: Our commitment to making Union Eyes accessible to all users, including those with disabilities.
accessibility.heading: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Union Eyes is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people of all abilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying relevant accessibility standards.
accessibility.standardsDesc: We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA and comply with the Accessible Canada Act (ACA). Our platform is regularly audited for accessibility compliance.
accessibility.feature3: High contrast mode and customizable colour schemes
accessibility.feature4: Resizable text without loss of functionality
accessibility.feature5: Alternative text for all meaningful images
accessibility.feature6: ARIA landmarks and semantic HTML structure
accessibility.limitationsDesc: While we strive for full accessibility, some third-party components may have limitations. We are actively working with our vendors to improve these areas.
accessibility.feedbackDesc: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of Union Eyes. Please contact us at

pricingBody.heading: Contract-Based Deployment
pricingBody.subtitle: One contract per organization. Parent-level billing. Transparent allocation to every local.
pricingBody.contractDesc: Union Eyes is deployed under a single organizational contract. The parent body holds the agreement, selects modules, and sets governance controls. No per-seat pricing, no surprise tiers.
pricingBody.parentBillingDesc: One invoice to the parent organization. Costs are allocated transparently across locals, chapters, and regions based on membership count, module usage, or a custom formula you define.
pricingBody.allocationDesc: Every local sees exactly what they cost and what they use. Treasurers get allocation breakdowns, per capita tracking, and reconciliation reports without needing parent-level access.
pricingBody.modulePricingDesc: You activate only the modules your organization needs. Each module is priced independently and can be enabled or disabled at the contract level.
pricingBody.included5: Full audit trail on all operations
pricingBody.ctaDescription: Every engagement starts with a controlled pilot. We work with your team to define scope, select modules, and validate the platform against your real workflows.
pricingBody.trustLine1: All contracts include PIPEDA-compliant data handling and bilingual (EN/FR) support.
pricingBody.trustLine2: No per-seat pricing. No credit systems. One contract, one invoice, full transparency.

trust.heroHeading: Built for the organizations that can least afford to get it wrong
trust.heroDescription: Union Eyes is designed for financial accountability, operational transparency, and defensible data governance. Every feature, every module, every audit trail exists because unions demanded it.
trust.auditDesc: Every action on the platform is logged with who, what, when, and why. Audit logs are immutable, exportable, and available to authorized roles at any time.
trust.rbacDesc: Members, stewards, officers, treasurers, and admins each see exactly what they need. Access is scoped by organization, role, and entitlement — never by assumption.
trust.dataDesc: All data is stored in Canadian Azure data centres. No cross-border transfers. Full compliance with PIPEDA and applicable provincial privacy legislation.
trust.reconDesc: Platform billing reconciles against your internal ledgers. Allocation is transparent. Every dollar is accounted for from parent invoice to local cost centre.
trust.entitlementDesc: Modules and capabilities are activated through the deployment contract. Nothing is on by default. Organization admins control what is available and to whom.
trust.defensibilityDesc: Evidence sealing, grievance chain of custody, and tamper-evident records. When your decisions are challenged, the platform provides the proof.

trust.auditLogDescription: All system actions are logged immutably. Audit logs cannot be modified or deleted, only archived after the retention period.
trust.immutabilityDetails: Database-level triggers prevent modification of historical records. Once written, data cannot be altered or deleted.
trust.updateTriggers: UPDATE triggers reject all modification attempts
trust.rlsDetails: PostgreSQL RLS policies ensure complete org data isolation. Organizations cannot access each other's data.
trust.fsmDetails: State transition rules enforced at application layer. Invalid transitions are blocked before database operations.
trust.governanceDetails: Golden share structure ensures union control over mission-critical decisions.
trust.classVotingRights: Class B voting rights on strategic decisions
trust.securityDescriptionContact: We're committed to transparency. If you have questions about any of these safeguards or want to discuss Union Eyes security in depth, reach out to our team.
